items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I don't know. I wasn't there. But it's my understanding that -- well, I know when I was there, Billy Strayhorn only wrote for Johnny Hodges.

ctx.x: And then he had -- well, he had a real beautiful ballad or something for Johnny, didn't he? "Warm Valley", or something like that. I think there was -- let me just --
I think Billy Strayhorn used to do all of Johnny's things, didn't he?
